📍 Diani Beach, Kenya · 2 hours ago

Diani at golden hour never gets old. 🌅 Found this quiet stretch of beach 2km south of the main strip — no crowds, just powdery white sand and warm Indian Ocean. Full journal dropping tomorrow!

Kofi Mensah

📍 Accra, Ghana · 5 hours ago

Pro tip for anyone flying into Kotoka International: skip the taxi queue entirely. Use the Ziarra transfer booking — my driver was there before I cleared customs, and the car had chilled water and a phone charger. 🙌 Ghana is going off this year — book early!

Leila Osei

📍 Marrakech, Morocco · Yesterday

Three days in the Medina and I still find new streets every morning. Had the best harira of my life in a tiny riad just off Jemaa el-Fna. The couple running it have been there for 40 years. These are the moments that make travel worth everything.
